title: SoK: ARCUS: On the Efficiency and Efficacy of Hardware Fuzzing
abstract: arXiv:2608.23933v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This work presents a comprehensive analysis of contemporary hardware fuzzing techniques applied across three major abstraction layers: Instruction Set Architecture (ISA), microarchitecture, and Register-Transfer Level (RTL). Our study examines key factors including input stimulus quality, mutation strategies, feedback mechanisms, target platforms, reference models, and achieved coverage. We find challenges, goals, and design trade-offs vary significantly across abstraction layers. We further identify several unmet needs in current hardware fuzzing practices, such as intelligent input generation, reliable and scalable golden reference models, expressive feedback channels, and cross-layer integration. Building on these insights, we outline future research directions, including hybrid fuzzing frameworks, AI-assisted test generation, scalable reference models, standardized evaluation metrics and benchmarks, and human-in-the-loop automation

translated_title: SoK：ARCUS——硬件模糊测试的效率与效能研究
translated_abstract: 本文对当代硬件模糊测试技术进行了全面分析，涵盖了三大抽象层次：指令集架构（ISA）、微架构和寄存器传输级（RTL）。我们的研究考察了关键因素，包括输入刺激质量、变异策略、反馈机制、目标平台、参考模型以及实现的覆盖率。我们发现，各抽象层次在挑战、目标和设计权衡方面存在显著差异。我们进一步识别了当前硬件模糊测试实践中的若干未满足需求，例如智能输入生成、可靠且可扩展的黄金参考模型、表达性强的反馈通道以及跨层集成。基于这些见解，我们概述了未来研究方向，包括混合模糊测试框架、AI辅助测试生成、可扩展参考模型、标准化评估指标和基准，以及人在回路的自动化。
tldr: 本文系统分析了硬件模糊测试在ISA、微架构和RTL三个抽象层次上的效率与效能，指出了现有实践中的关键缺陷，并提出了包括混合框架、AI辅助生成和标准化评估在内的未来研究方向。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically analyzes the efficiency and efficacy of hardware fuzzing across ISA, microarchitecture, and RTL abstraction layers, identifies key gaps in current practices, and proposes future directions including hybrid frameworks, AI-assisted generation, and standardized evaluation.
